main_body: A side-profile chair (L-shaped silhouette) facing east, with a tall backrest on the right and a seat extending left, on thin legs
top_band: none: the seat at rows 10-11 (L=124) is only a 2-row tan edge, with a 1-row lighter line at row 12; no horizontal surface is wide enough to read as a top
evidence: The chair is drawn as a side-profile silhouette like the red 'side elevation chair' in the guide. The column at x=5 and x=7 shows a 1-row outline, then 2 rows of mid-tone (the seat edge), a 1-row highlight and a dark underside, so the seat is only a 2px band and not a visible top surface. The backrest at x=9 is a vertical column of the same tone, and the legs are thin dark lines. There is no seat top seen from above, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and the median tile figure is 0 because the piece is smaller than one tile. The wood has about 3 tones (a light edge, a mid-brown and a dark brown), against 5-6 steps in the references. The outlines are partly dark brown and partly neutral black (47% neutral), so they are mixed, and the black legs read as a sticker. The body is a plain mid-brown with no grain or texture dots. It is thinner and flatter than both references.
